project_type: Spring Boot + Vert.x Kotlin backend with Vue 2 frontend (two separate frontend apps)
test_framework: No tests found in current state (Spring Boot test dependency present but no test files)
verification_instructions: 1. Run ./gradlew compileKotlin compileJava -x test and verify BUILD SUCCESSFUL. 2. For Vue frontend: cd web && npx vue-cli-service build (if node_modules available). 3. Verify new Vue components exist in web/src/components/. 4. Verify simple-web-src/ has readable source files.
snapshot_or_generated_files: src/main/resources/web/ is the compiled Vue output (generated by 'yarn sync' in web/). src/main/resources/simple-web/ is the simple-web compiled output.
setup_instructions: Backend: ./gradlew compileKotlin compileJava -x test. Frontend: cd web && yarn install && yarn build.
environment_constraints: Java 11 and Gradle 6.1.1 available via gradlew wrapper. Node v22 available. Network mode allows package installs.
key_patterns: Vue components use Element UI dialogs with model prop 'show'/event 'setShow'. API calls via Axios with this.api + '/endpoint'. Backend uses Vert.x Router with coroutineHandler. Controllers extend BaseController. Event bus (eventBus.js) for cross-component communication. The compiled frontend uses path-based routes like /file/list, /httpTTS/list while backend has flat routes like /reader3/getFileList.
directory_structure: / - project root with build.gradle.kts, gradlew. /web/ - Vue 2 frontend source with package.json. /web/src/components/ - Vue components. /web/src/views/ - Index.vue and Reader.vue pages. /web/src/plugins/ - axios, vuex, config, helpers. /src/main/java/com/htmake/reader/ - Kotlin backend. /src/main/java/com/htmake/reader/api/ - YueduApi.kt (router) and controller/. /src/main/resources/web/ - compiled Vue output. /src/main/resources/simple-web/ - compiled simple-web output.
